title: Graph Engineering barrier vote
description: Value an upstream node must produce when it is bound to a quorum barrier. A malformed vote is the non-retryable node failure INVALID_BARRIER_VOTE after exactly one attempt; it is never coerced to abstain or unknown and never counts as a participant.

evidence.description: Optional portable JSON retained only as a canonical hash in the durable decision. Retention of the raw value is governed by the redaction contract.
